messages:
Alicia: Quick sync — planning to roll SDK/gateway change for SDK v2.5.1 to hosted tomorrow 08:00 PT. Need: who pulls the trigger, smoke checklist owners, rollback owner, and client comms plan. Window ~30m. Canaries first. Who can own what?
Sam: I can own rollback and the smoke scripts. I'll be oncall then.
Jordan: I can draft the client advisory and update release notes. Will push PR by EOD.
Priya: I'll run perf + end-to-end smoke after canary. Any tests I should pay close attention to?
Alicia: Thanks — plan is: canary 5% (5m) -> regional 50% (10m) -> full (15m). Rollback is immediate to `sdk-v2.5.0` tag. Focus on latency P50/P95, error rate, and token accounting.
Sam: Putting quick smoke command here — run after canary:
```
# quick smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-sdk-v25","input":"ping"}' | jq -r '.output'
```
I added infra/tools/smoke-sdk25.sh and gave it exec perms.
Priya: Noted. Also will run the binding-compat suite (client-bindings >= 1.9). If any test fails I'll call rollback.
Jordan: Drafted comms: short advisory to #announcements + email to active API keys. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/483 — please review. Also adding quick migration note for users who pin model names.
Alicia: Who watches metrics during the window? Suggest @oncall-sre + Sam for alert triage, Priya watches perf, Jordan handles comms.
oncall-sre: I'll monitor P50/P95 latency, error-rate, and cpu/gpu utilisation. Alert thresholds: error-rate > 0.5%, p95 increase > 2x baseline.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created for 2025-08-24 08:00 PT (unix: 1758090000) — reminder set.
Sam: I'll stand by for rollback up to +1h after cutover. :thumbsup: 
Alicia: Great — final checklist: 1) rollback tag ready (Sam) 2) smoke script ready (Sam) 3) perf/e2e watcher (Priya) 4) comms + PR (Jordan) 5) metrics watcher (oncall-sre). If anyone else wants to be on the call, reply here. :eyes:
Jordan: I'll post the advisory 24h before and a short follow-up after deploy.
Priya: A few quick notes — disable long-running batch jobs during window, and keep a small canary quota for retries.
Sam: copying runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/sdk-deploys — we should have rollback steps pinned.
Alicia: Thanks all. I'll start the canary at 08:00 PT unless someone objects in next 12h.
